description: List or search objects (recorded, locator-bound UI elements) in the connected product's shared Object Repository. Requires a live connection (qa_connect). Returns a summary — id, name, object type and locator count — never full locator bags (use object_get for one in full). Omit `limit`/`offset` to fetch the ENTIRE project object list (paged internally, up to 2000); pass either one to control a single page yourself instead.

limit.description: Return exactly one page of this size, starting at `offset`, instead of fetching everything.

offset.description: Result offset for a single manual page (implies a one-page fetch; default page size 100 if `limit` is omitted).

pageName.description: Filter by captured page / screen name.

query.description: Free-text search over the object name / description.

name: object_list
title: List / search objects in the shared Object Repository
